description: Search the LinkedIn Ad Library, LinkedIn's public ad-transparency archive, by advertiser name or keyword, optionally by country and date range: advertiser, ad text, headline, format, landing page, and (with includeDetails) run dates, impression ranges and targeting as LinkedIn publishes them. Up to 20 ads per call. Best-effort: LinkedIn sometimes blocks automated access, and a failed run returns 503 within about 40 s and is not charged; /v1/ads/meta is the more reliable ad source. Provided by Atlas Data (third-party seller); cached up to 6 h. Price 0.02 USD per call via x402.

advertiser.description: Comma-separated advertiser (company) names, up to 3, e.g. "HubSpot". Required unless keyword is set.

countries.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes where ads were shown, up to 10 (empty = all)

includeDetails.description: Open each ad for full text, dates, impressions and targeting (much slower and more likely to fail or time out; keep maxItems small). Default false.

keyword.description: Comma-separated keyword searches in ad text, up to 3; with advertiser, a single filter word.

startDate.description: Custom range start (YYYY-MM-DD, last 12 months only); replaces dateRange

name: linkedin_ads
